text.en: Make-A-Scene is row 26 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Multimodal area.
text.zh: Make-A-Scene 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 26 行，所属领域为“多模态”。

text.en: The annual table associates Make-A-Scene with “Make-A-Scene: Scene-Based Text-to-Image Generation with Human Priors”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Make-A-Scene 与论文《Make-A-Scene: Scene-Based Text-to-Image Generation with Human Priors》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Oran Gafni, Yaniv Taigman”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Oran Gafni（官方页拼写）、Yaniv Taigman（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Oran Gafni, Yaniv Taigman”。
